item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Reinaldo — a System Administrator who genuinely enjoys making technology work smoothly, securely, and reliably for the people who depend on it.

For the past several years, I’ve cared for networks, servers, and systems in healthcare environments — places where downtime isn’t just inconvenient, it matters. I’ve reduced security risks, improved system availability, and helped colleagues grow through knowledge sharing. I work with Linux and Windows, Python, Docker, FreeBSD (pfSense), and I value Agile approaches like SCRUM. But more than tools, I value the people behind the screens.

item.title: Advantages of Hugo for Creating Personal Websites
item.description:
Hugo turns the creation of a personal site into a process measured in seconds, not minutes. While other tools force you to wait between builds, Hugo renders entire sites in fractions of a second, eliminating the friction between writing and publishing.

Performance Without Compromise

Hugo is written in Go, a high-performance compiled language. The practical result: each piece of content renders in approximately 1 millisecond, and a moderately sized site builds instantly. A blog with hundreds or thousands of articles compiles in under a second — something unthinkable in generators based on Ruby or JavaScript.
